ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the figure, the horizontal axis is 1950—2010, and the vertical direction represents changes in urban population and urbanization level. Curve ① is overall at a relatively high position, the urbanization level is relatively high, and its later growth is relatively slow; curve ② has a relatively low starting point, but continues to rise clearly over time, with a relatively fast growth rate. Reasoning: ① can be understood as the urbanization process of developed countries, and ② can be understood as the urbanization process of developing countries. Although the urbanization stages and speeds of the two types of countries are different, urban population concentration, expansion of construction land, and increases in industrial and transportation activities will all bring problems such as pollution, ecological damage, and resource pressure. Therefore, the common impact of the two in the process of urbanization development is that both will have impacts on the environment to different degrees.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中①曲线城市化水平较高、增长较缓，②曲线起点较低但持续快速上升。再结合题干询问①、②代表的国家在城市化发展中的“共同影响”。把①理解为发达国家城市化过程，②理解为发展中国家城市化过程；虽然二者城市化阶段和速度不同，但城市人口集中、建设用地扩张和产业活动增加都会带来污染、生态破坏或资源压力。因此回答：都会对环境产生不同程度的影响。
